使(道路等)堵塞，塞住：
The traffic was jammed for an hour.
交通阻塞了一个小时。

What worried him was that his broken key jammed the lock.
让他焦急不安的是折断的钥匙把锁孔给卡住了。

这艘船被夹在两块暗礁之间。
轧伤，挤伤，扭伤；压碎，碾碎：
His finger was jammed in a train door.
他的手指被火车门轧伤了。
The man jammed out his cigarette to show his respect for the lady.
那个男人拈灭了香烟以显示他对该女士的尊敬。
猛推，猛压；拉紧，抽紧：
The driver
jammed his foot on the brake.

He had no choice but to jam his way through the crowd.
